# docs-host-obsidian-vault

Raw Obsidian vault export from host machine.

## Stack & contents

Pure markdown vault, ~6,665 files across `host/{JarvisAI_vault, Trajans_Tech_Serious_Vault, ...}`. No SOURCE_CONTEXT file (raw mirror).

## Why this is here

Largest single corpus of pre-existing knowledge. Use grep-first; never load the whole tree. Especially useful for prior research on agent platforms (`Research/Self-Hosted AI Agent Platforms 2026.md`) and architecture (`Architecture/System Overview.md`).

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git ls-tree -r origin/docs-host-obsidian-vault --name-only | grep -i <topic> | head
git show origin/docs-host-obsidian-vault:host/JarvisAI_vault/Architecture/'System Overview.md'
```
